name: Volunteer Program, Academy of Natural Sciences
org: Academy of Natural Sciences of Drexel University
what_you_do: You can help in collections departments and the Patrick Center lab. You can help with Bird Safe Philly, a bird-collision program. You can also help with Nature at Noon walks. Roles vary. Not all are open to teens.
who_can_apply: Minimum age is 14. The page lists no teen-specific roles; ask which positions accept teens.
duration: Regular time from half a day to several days a week, for at least one year
how_to_apply: Complete the online application linked on the page, then email the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteers@ansp.org about specific openings.
notes: The page does not say which areas teens can join. Bird Safe Philly runs April to May and September to November.
